ma.sendSocketMessage(Object object)

Send data through the WebSocket connection. The data can be sent only after ma.connectSocket is called and ma.onSocketOpen is called back.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
data String Yes Content to be sent.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

    let socketOpen = false
    let socketMsgQueue = []
    ma.connectSocket({
        url: 'test.php'
    })
    
    ma.onSocketOpen(function(res) {
       socketOpen = true
       for (let i = 0; i < socketMsgQueue.length; i++){
           sendSocketMessage(socketMsgQueue[i])
       }
       socketMsgQueue = []
    })
    
    function sendSocketMessage(msg) {
        if (socketOpen) {
            ma.sendSocketMessage({
             data:msg
            })
        } else {
            socketMsgQueue.push(msg)
        }
    }
